core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hazm is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Firmness, determination, resoluteness”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hazm corresponds to the Arabic form حزم (Arabic root ح ز م (ḥ-z-m); حَزْم (Ḥazm)). Its core sense is resolute, determined, firm of purpose. Hazm is Arabic حَزْم (Ḥazm) 'firmness, determination, resoluteness', from the root ح ز م (ḥ-z-m). The source gloss 'Wisdom and Insight' is broadly consistent. Recorded at medium confidence because the word is primarily a common noun. Same name as hazem and hazim.

persian.name: حزم
persian.long_meaning: Hazm (حزم) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن استوار، قاطع، مصمم است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
